messages.subject: Project Quartz — Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Good to be working with you on this. Attached are draft Heads of Terms reflecting the commercial position: enterprise value £42.5m, cash-free debt-free, £3m deferred over 12 months, an £2m retention, and a 30-month non-compete from the Founders. Exclusivity to 28 February. Subject to contract, of course. Look forward to your comments.

James

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks. Broadly workable. Our clients will want to discuss the retention mechanism (they'd prefer W&I insurance to reduce it) and the 30-month covenant feels long for Patricia, who will step back at completion. We can live with exclusivity to 28 Feb. I'll send a marked-up version, but no need to delay kick-off of diligence.

Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP
